obfuscation_indicators: various trends and factors beyond our control
not necessarily inclusive of all important factors
assumed facts almost always vary from actual results
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and presents strong operating performance, growing utilization, low leverage, covenant compliance, and substantial contracted capacity. Risk is tempered by exposure to commodity prices, contract terminations, customer creditworthiness, foreign operations, asset seizure history, and reliance on assumptions for deferred tax assets. The extensive forward-looking disclaimer language is largely standard boilerplate and limits interpretability of future expectations.
